environment.description: Production Rails 7.1 API running on ECS Fargate. Split.io SDK configured with API key pointing to production Split environment. The 'user_profile_update_mode' split definition has targeting rules that return 'flexible' for all users in organizations with plan='enterprise' and 'strict' for free-tier users. However, the default rule (catch-all) returns 'flexible'. Any user not matching specific targeting rules gets the flexible code path. The application has no additional authorization middleware or parameter filtering beyond what's in the controller.

config.network_config: Direct internet-facing ALB with no WAF
config.iam_config: ECS task role with standard RDS access
